privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Draft, to be reviewed before launch
privacy.collectBody: Your name, email address and password (stored only as a secure hash) when you create an account, plus the events you save and the organisers you follow. Organisers also give a contact number and, optionally, an SSM registration number.
privacy.whyBody: To run your account, show and remind you about events, verify organisers, and process payments. We do not sell your data.
privacy.whereBody: On Supabase servers in Singapore. Access is restricted so each user can only see their own personal data.
privacy.rightsBody: Under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, and withdraw consent at any time by closing your account.
